contact_name.value: Carey J. Bocklet Chief Operating Officer of GEL Laboratories, LLC

services.value: GEL Laboratories provides environmental and radiological analytical testing services including environmental chemistry (organic, inorganic, wet chemistry), radiochemistry, radiobioassay, PFAS analytical testing, hemp testing, special handling analyses, and lead in drinking water. The site also describes organic chemistry analyses (e.g., GC/MS for volatile/semi-volatile organics) and inorganic/metal analyses (e.g., ICP-MS/ICP/CVAA) as part of its laboratory services.
